response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform expertise; their work is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang with minimal evidence of cloud compute architecture or distributed systems leadership, and they have no documented technical leadership experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across multiple languages and domains
Active open-source contributor with demonstrated tooling and infrastructure projects
Proven mentorship through workshops, code katas, and community teaching
concerns: Only 1-2 years of C++ experience (LabWindows/CVI), far below 8-year requirement
No evidence of cloud compute platform ownership or large-scale distributed systems design
Lacks formal technical leadership roles mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers
